position: Reviewer observations are explicit and session only
headline: Human judgment now has a visible place without becoming hidden analytics.
copy: Nothing is saved automatically. The reviewer chooses what to record, copy, and clear, and the packet labels its limits.

postures.title: Source fit
postures.copy: Reviewers assess whether the citation actually carries the response.

postures.title: Boundary quality
postures.copy: Reviewers assess whether overclaim and authority limits are clear.

postures.title: Usefulness
postures.copy: A simple rating captures whether the response helps the learner.

postures.title: Persistence
postures.copy: Refreshing the page clears the review session.

postures.title: Telemetry
postures.copy: No observation leaves the browser automatically.

flow.title: Choose
flow.copy: Select the runbook scenario being reviewed.

flow.title: Assess
flow.copy: Set source fit, boundary quality, and usefulness.

flow.title: Note
flow.copy: Add a concise human observation without learner identifiers.

flow.title: Control
flow.copy: Copy the packet deliberately or clear the session.

decisions.label: Default
decisions.reason: Observation capture starts empty on every page load.

decisions.label: Identity
decisions.reason: The prototype does not claim authenticated reviewer identity.

decisions.label: Export
decisions.reason: Review packets move only through an explicit reviewer action.

decisions.label: Production
decisions.reason: Real review operations need accounts, permissions, retention, and audit policy.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No model call or generated scripture is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable learner, reviewer, observation, or telemetry storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No translation text is published without recorded rights evidence.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The product remains study and reflection support, not a guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private-demo evidence does not authorize a public service.

packet:
Reviewer Observation Capture v4.8.3
Storage: memory only.
Export: explicit copy action.
Prohibited: learner identifiers, hidden telemetry, automatic upload, and implied reviewer approval.
